opening.T1: I'll prepare: {deliverable}. I'll check it before I call it done.
opening.T2: I'll prepare: {deliverable}. This needs careful checking, so it may take longer.
opening.estimate: Similar tasks took about {lo} to {hi} minutes{money}.
refused: I can't help with this kind of decision. Please ask a qualified professional.
handoff: I've paused this task so you can answer when ready. Reply here to continue.
stopped_budget: I did {done} of {total} and stopped at your limit. Nothing else was sent or changed. Finishing needs about {more}. Continue?
stopped_stall: Stuck: I stopped before finishing, and nothing was sent or changed. Say continue to try again, or tell me what to change.
definition: I'll count {metric} as {inclusions}, excluding {exclusions}, in {unit}.{extra} Is that right?
assumption_sheet: These are the numbers I'll assume. The first ones matter most. Change any of them, or say OK.
header.basis: Based on {source}, with data up to {as_of}. Excludes: {exclusions}. Rows used: {rows}.
header.checked: Checked: every row is accounted for, in or out of the period, and adds up to the file.
header.not_for_tax: Don't use this for tax or payments yet.
header.rows_left_out_unparsable: {n} rows whose amount could not be read
plan.head: Before I start, here is the research plan ({sha}):
plan.private: I won't search for your customers' or suppliers' names.
plan.ask: Reply yes to approve this plan, or say what to change.
sources_disagree: Your {a} says {x}; {b} says {y}. The gap of {gap} is not explained. I've shown both.
incomplete_data: Incomplete: your file ends on {date}, before the end of the period.
restated: Restated: the earlier figure changes from {old} to {new}, because the definition of {metric} changed.
prepared_not_sent: I've prepared this. Nothing was sent or changed.
disconnect: Connection lost. Your work is saved. Nothing was sent. Continue when you're ready.
decision_card: My suggestion: {suggestion} (range: {range}). This changes if {flip}. Assumptions you haven't confirmed: {unconfirmed}. This advice goes stale after {stale}.
scenario_note: This is a scenario, not a prediction.
model.pending_card: A task card is needed first. Write it to .claude/loops/drafts/card.json and run harness-compile --card on it; until then only reads are allowed.
model.tripwire: This is bigger than a quick answer. Before going further, draft a task card and compile it (harness-card, then harness-compile). Until then only reads are allowed.
definition.sources: When sources differ, I use them in this order: {order}.
